minimum_ruling: Display the chance as conditional on the named current model/target/period; distinguish finite-simulation precision from uncertainty in inputs, source and model structure; show the existing resolved chance-driver comparison when available and label its method; explicitly say which uncertainty has not been quantified. A generic ranking warning or sampling interval alone is not assumption uncertainty. No new fragile-assumption sweep is universally required: the existing same-Run resolved driver groups are useful quantitative sensitivity evidence, though not a causal intervention or total epistemic probability interval. With no resolved driver, say this limit rather than invent a range or call the chance robust.
range_distinction: An actual range from deliberately varied plausible assumptions can be shown as scenario sensitivity with its varied/held assumptions, source and scope. The Wilson interval is simulation precision only. Low/high driver-group probabilities are conditional fractions in existing draws, not bounds on the true chance or a controlled one-input sweep. Preserve correlated flags and presence conditioning. None establishes real-world calibration or complete goal/horizon validity.

exact_copy.precision_template: Simulation sampling: {n_met} of {n_informative} cases met this target; the {confidence_level}% sampling interval is {interval_lower_percent}–{interval_upper_percent}%. This interval treats the model and its input distributions as fixed; it does not cover mistakes or missing evidence in them.
exact_copy.driver_template: Model sensitivity: for {driver}, {presence_scope}the goal was met in about {p_goal_if_low_percent}% of cases in the weaker third of sampled strengths and about {p_goal_if_high_percent}% in the stronger third ({n_low} and {n_high} cases). These are conditional groups from this Run, not a confidence interval or a test of changing only this link.
exact_copy.assumption_limit: Olumi supplied this uncertain link. Evidence about its strength could materially change this model estimate. Uncertainty from missing evidence, alternative assumptions and model structure is not quantified here.
exact_copy.no_resolved_driver: This Run did not resolve a reliable comparison of how uncertain assumptions affect this chance. Its sampling interval does not answer that question.
exact_copy.hiring_tech_lead_precision: Simulation sampling: 1,344 of 10,000 cases met this target; the 95% sampling interval is 12.8–14.1%. This interval treats the model and its input distributions as fixed; it does not cover mistakes or missing evidence in them.
exact_copy.hiring_tech_lead_driver: Model sensitivity: for the Tech lead → Leadership capacity link, where the link was present, the goal was met in about 0.15% of cases in the weaker third of sampled strengths and about 42% in the stronger third (2,668 cases per group). These are conditional groups from this Run, not a confidence interval or a test of changing only this link.
exact_copy.hiring_developers_low_count: Only 1 of 10,000 simulated cases reached this target. The 95% simulation sampling interval is about 0.0018–0.0566%. This Run did not resolve a reliable assumption-sensitivity comparison. A low estimate in this model does not rule out the target in reality.

implementation: Use the existing selected Run precision/driver/source/licence facts in AI input through step20. AI explains them; exact text is source-bound wording support, not a new host answer composer, forced paragraph, probability law, reader, store, model call or sweep harness. K1 must match the correct computed statistic and scope: conditional driver fractions cannot be substituted for or rewritten into the headline probability. Only use numeric copy where the existing contract actually licenses that statistic; otherwise record the representation limit, never fabricate or weaken a guard.
acceptance_limit: Original hiring judge FAIL remains. This ruling gives an honest minimum uncertainty face, not a retrospective condition5 PASS or waived original rubric. Actual supported horizon, saved source/assumptions, complete useful rendered answer, full four journeys and cold continuation still need the existing independent witness/judge. No automatic full-readiness or calibrated real-world probability claim.
